relationships.subject: GSK-650394
relationships.evidence_quote: intrathecal injection of GSK-650394 effectively reversed the DNP-enhanced pSGK1/tSGK1 in the DNP+GSK group

relationships.subject: GSK-650394
relationships.evidence_quote: Daily administration of GSK-650394 alleviated DNP allodynia

relationships.subject: SGK1
relationships.evidence_quote: Furthermore, intrathecal administration of the SGK1 specific inhibitor GSK-650394 decreased HDAC4 phosphorylation and cytoplasmic HDAC4 restriction.

relationships.subject: SGK1
relationships.evidence_quote: Administration of GSK-650394 decreased the expression of HMGB1

relationships.subject: HDAC4
relationships.evidence_quote: neuropathic injury promotes cytoplasmic HDAC4 accumulation, which uncouples HDAC4 from the hmgb1 gene to epigenetically alleviate HDAC4-suppressed HMGB1 transcription, resulting in increased HMGB1 expression in dorsal horn neurons

key_findings: Spinal pSGK1 and pHDAC4 are persistently increased in type 2 diabetic neuropathic pain rats; SGK1 inhibition with GSK-650394 reduces pHDAC4, cytoplasmic HDAC4 and HMGB1 and relieves hypersensitivity.
SGK1-HDAC4-HMGB1 signaling in dorsal horn neurons contributes to type 2 DNP.
